c: Bury whole carrots in coarse salt; bake 180 °C 60 min; crack, peel; slice thin lengthways.
Marinate in oil, smoked salt, lemon and dill 24 h at 4 °C.
Mix flours, yeast, sugar, salt and warm oat milk; prove 1 h; fold in whipped aquafaba.
Cook 4 cm blini on an oiled pan 1 min per side.
Top each with 10 g cashew crème fraîche (see components), a carrot ribbon, dill; 3 per cover.

c: Halve onions; char cut side black in a dry pan, then roast 200 °C 30 min.
Cold-soak kombu and shiitake 1 h; add onions; heat to 80 °C; steep 30 min; strain; season with soy and mirin.
Char leek rounds on the plancha; blend chives with oil 70 °C, filter.
Warm cup: 2 leek rounds, 70 ml dashi, 4 drops chive oil.

Dress with shallot, capers, mustard, vinegar, oil and salt; ring 60 g per cover.
Halve plums; cold-smoke 10 min; cook with sugar to a thick compote.
Soak cashews 4 h; blend with water, horseradish and lemon to a thick cream.
Slice rye 1 mm, bake 150 °C 12 min. Plate tartare, plum dots, cream quenelle, rye shard.

c: Knead semolina and warm water 10 min; rest 30 min covered.
Roll 1 cm ropes; cut 1.5 cm; drag with 2 fingers (or a cavatelli board); dry on semolina.
Sear mushrooms hard in batches; add shallot, garlic, chopped soaked porcini; deglaze with wine; add jus; reduce to coat.
Cook pasta 3–4 min; toss in ragù with pasta water; 70 g pasta + ragù; gremolata on top.

c: Cut stems into 2.5 cm rounds; score a fine crosshatch on both sides.
Simmer 5 min in kombu dashi (seasons); dry well.
Sear in oil until deep golden 2 min per side; baste with plant butter; 3 per cover.
Simmer cauliflower in oat milk until soft; blend with oil to silky; season.
Fry capers crisp; crumble toasted nori.
Purée swipe, 3 'scallops', 30 ml beurre blanc, capers and nori.

c: Juice clementines (≈ 550 g); warm sugar, glucose and water; infuse thyme 10 min; strain.
Mix with juice and lemon (26–28° Brix); chill 4 h; churn.
Chilled bowl: 40 g quenelle, 2 drops olive oil, a flake of salt.
Rub whole celeriac with oil and salt; roast 180 °C 2 h until tender to a skewer; rest; cut 10 wedges.
Blend black garlic, soy and maple; brush wedges; glaze 220 °C 6 min.
Simmer lentils with diced carrot 20 min; drain; season with vinegar and oil.
Fry thin shallot rings cold-start until golden; drain.
Wilt kale; plate lentils, kale, celeriac wedge, 40 ml hot jus, crispy shallots.

c: Boil oat milk, coconut cream, sugar and starch 1 min; pour over chocolate; blend; stream in olive oil.
Pipe into a tray or moulds; set 4 h at 4 °C.
Segment oranges; set juice with agar and blend to a gel.
Caramelise sugar, add hazelnuts, cool, crush; rub flour and plant butter, bake 160 °C 12 min, mix with praline.
Plate crumb, 60 g crémeux quenelle, segments, gel dots, salt flakes.

Add sugar and glucose; cook to 106 °C; add lemon; pour; set 12 h; cut 2 cm; roll in sugar.

c: Reduce shallots, wine and vinegar to 2 tbsp; add oat milk; bring to the simmer.
Off heat whisk in cold plant butter cubes gradually; shear 0.5 g xanthan with a stick blender for stability.
Strain; season with lemon and salt; hold at 55–60 °C max (splits above 65 °C).

c: Soak cashews 6 h; rinse; blend with water to completely smooth (2–3 min high speed).
Stir in live coconut yoghurt; cover with cloth; culture 18–24 h at 24 °C until tangy.
Season with lemon and salt; chill 4 h to thicken.

c: Reduce aquafaba from 300 g to 200 g if thin (consistency of egg white); cool.
Whip with lemon to soft peaks (5 min); add sugar + starch slowly; whip to stiff glossy peaks (10 min).
Pipe; dry 90 °C 2–2.5 h; cool in the oven.
Cook sugar and water to 118 °C; stream onto aquafaba whipping at soft peak; whip to cool.
Pipe and torch; holds 4 h at room temperature.
96b2c98f.st: Baked meringues airtight with silica, 1 week.

c: Infuse vanilla in hot oat milk and coconut cream.
Whisk sugar, starch, turmeric (colour) and salt; temper in; boil 2 min whisking until glossy.
Off heat whisk in plant butter; film to contact; chill fast to < 5 °C.

c: Melt plant butter; add ground hazelnuts; cook gently until the nuts toast golden and nutty (plant butter will not brown alone).
Off heat whisk in miso and hazelnut oil; strain or keep the toasted crumbs.
Use like beurre noisette; for desserts omit miso, add a pinch of salt.
Check every label: no gelatine, carmine (E120), shellac, honey, fish sauce, anchovy (Worcestershire), whey, casein, egg lysozyme, isinglass-fined wine.
Use certified vegan wine/sake for cooking; vegan sugar (no bone-char) if required by guest; dairy-free chocolate.
Green-coded boards, pans and containers; prepare plant-based mise en place first; separate fryer oil.
Never baste with dairy butter or finish with stock on the same pan; label every container 'PB'.
Allergens remain: nuts, sesame, soy, gluten, mustard, celery—declare from the TTK for each course.
Server briefs each course; confirm guest diet (vegan vs. vegetarian vs. allergy) at order and on the ticket.
